name: Scheme I - Product Certification Scheme (ISI Mark)
description: The flagship certification scheme under BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations, 2018. Involves factory evaluation, sample testing in independent laboratory, and continual surveillance audits.
eligibility: Manufacturers having requisite manufacturing infrastructure, testing equipment, and competent quality control personnel at their manufacturing premises.
applicable_categories: Electrical appliances, drinking water, pressure cookers, cement, steel, toys, automotive helmets, chemicals, food products.
governing_regulation: Schedule II, Scheme I of BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations, 2018

workflow_steps.title: Identification of Standard & Scope
workflow_steps.description: Identify the applicable Indian Standard (IS code) and ensure product conforms to all specified requirements.

workflow_steps.title: Establishment of In-House Laboratory
workflow_steps.description: Set up mandatory testing equipment at the factory according to the BIS Scheme of Inspection and Testing (SIT).

workflow_steps.title: Online Application Submission via Manakonline
workflow_steps.description: Submit application form along with manufacturing process details, plant layout, machinery list, and test personnel qualifications.

workflow_steps.title: Preliminary Factory Inspection
workflow_steps.description: BIS inspecting officer visits the factory, audits manufacturing infrastructure, witnesses test performance, and draws independent samples.

workflow_steps.title: Sample Testing in BIS Recognized Lab
workflow_steps.description: Drawn samples are dispatched to an authorized BIS Central or Recognized Laboratory for full independent verification.

workflow_steps.title: Scrutiny of Test Reports & Grant of Licence
workflow_steps.description: Upon satisfactory test reports and compliance resolution, BIS issues the Certification Marks Licence (CM/L number).

workflow_steps.title: Affixing ISI Mark & Market Surveillance
workflow_steps.description: Manufacturer commences production affixing the ISI mark alongside the CM/L number. Periodic surprise market sampling ensures compliance.

documents_required: Proof of factory premises ownership or registered lease deed
Factory layout plan and manufacturing process flow chart
Comprehensive list of manufacturing machinery with capacity
List of in-house testing equipment with valid calibration certificates
Consent letter from State Pollution Control Board (if applicable)
Certificate of incorporation/partnership deed and MSME/Udyam certificate
Appointment letter and qualification certificates of QC testing personnel
Undertaking regarding compliance to the Scheme of Inspection and Testing (SIT)

fee_structure.marking_fee: Product specific (e.g. ₹0.20 to ₹5 per unit produced or minimum annual marking fee ₹25,000 to ₹75,000)

name: Scheme II - Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS)
description: Self-declaration of conformity based on test reports from BIS recognized laboratories. Applies specifically to notified electronics and IT goods under Ministry of Electronics and IT (MeitY) orders.
eligibility: Manufacturers of notified electronic, optical storage, mobile phone, battery, and LED lighting equipment.
applicable_categories: Laptops, Tablets, Mobile Phones, Lithium-ion Batteries, LED Luminaires, Power Adapters, Smart Watches.
governing_regulation: Schedule II, Scheme II of BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations, 2018

workflow_steps.title: Sample Testing in BIS Recognized Lab
workflow_steps.description: Manufacturer submits test samples directly to any BIS-recognized Indian testing laboratory for conformity testing.

workflow_steps.title: Receipt of Valid Test Report
workflow_steps.description: Obtain test report conforming to the applicable Indian Standard (valid for 90 days from issuance date).

workflow_steps.title: Online Registration on CRS Portal
workflow_steps.description: Submit application on the BIS CRS portal, upload test reports, brand authorization (Affidavit), and business registrations.

workflow_steps.title: Grant of R-Number
workflow_steps.description: BIS scrutinizes documentation and grants unique Registration Number (R-XXXXXXXX) without factory inspection.

documents_required: Valid Test Report from BIS-recognized test lab (issued within 90 days)
Manufacturer ISO 9001 certificate or factory registration
Authorized Indian Representative (AIR) documentation for foreign manufacturers
Undertaking regarding compliance and product recall

fee_structure.processing_fee: ₹53,000 for 1 base model + up to 10 series models

name: Scheme IV - Grant of Hallmark for Precious Metals
description: Certification of gold and silver jewellery/artefacts ensuring certified purity. Granted to registered jewellers through recognized Assaying & Hallmarking Centres (A&HC).
eligibility: Any jeweller dealing in gold or silver jewellery, artefacts, or bullion.
applicable_categories: Gold jewellery, Gold coins, Silver artefacts, Silver utensils, Bullion bars.

workflow_steps.title: Online Jeweller Registration
workflow_steps.description: Jewellers register on Manakonline. Instant automatic grant of registration certificate without physical inspection.

workflow_steps.title: Submission of Jewellery to A&H Centre
workflow_steps.description: Jeweller creates online delivery memo on the BIS hallmarking portal and hands over jewellery lots to a recognized A&H centre.

workflow_steps.title: Assaying & Fire Assay Testing
workflow_steps.description: A&HC performs non-destructive XRF screening and gold cupellation/fire assay testing to verify declared purity (e.g. 22K916).

workflow_steps.title: Laser Inscription of HUID & BIS Logo
workflow_steps.description: Upon successful assaying, the central portal generates a unique 6-digit alphanumeric HUID which is laser engraved onto each piece.

documents_required: Proof of sales outlet / showroom premises (GST registration or municipal trade licence)
Proof of identity and address of proprietor / partners / directors

fee_structure.registration_fee: ₹0 for Micro-enterprises (Annual turnover < ₹5 Crore), ₹2,500 to ₹10,000 for higher turnover tiers
fee_structure.hallmarking_charge: ₹45 + GST per piece of gold jewellery; ₹35 + GST per piece of silver jewellery
